ambiguities_or_notes: Tolstoy's document body is already in English in the authoritative source and is preserved verbatim rather than retranslated from the editors' Russian rendering; this retains the historical spellings 'Vladimir Tchertkoff' and 'Moscou' and the source punctuation.

The editorial heading dates the item 25 February 1898, while Tolstoy's English document is signed 8 March 1898 and editorial note 5 identifies that date as New Style. The electronic 90-volume edition confirms this exact combination, so both dates are preserved without normalization.
Editorial notes 1–4 are Russian renderings of the English document's contents and are translated as editorial apparatus rather than substituted for Tolstoy's original English wording.

In editorial note 1, «все соглашения и связи с первым изданием» is rendered conservatively as 'all agreements and connections concerning the first publication'; the awkward pairing is retained rather than collapsed into the smoother source-English 'all arrangements in connection with'.
Editorial note 5's «Дата нового стиля» is rendered 'The date is New Style', preserving the editors' explicit calendrical designation.
